name: GLiDE 0.8B
note: Fastino's GLiDE 0.8B (Hugging Face fastino/GLiDE-0.8B @ 9eacdeec79fa48ec52a8d6f54b331376b4bbfaf0, Fastino Community License) on our GPU through the server its repository ships (python -m glide.server; env ~/envs/glide-family: CPython 3.12.13, torch 2.14.0+cu130, transformers 5.17.0, flash-linear-attention 0.5.2), BF16, GLIDE_MAX_BATCH=1 (one request at a time), no model field (the server passes only state and questions to the model), 255-way code readout; 255 options per request (the league's rule; longer lists split); never truncates: a question prompt over GLIDE_MAX_LEN 40,000 tokens is refused (422). League 1's longest stored request (251 options) is 28,323 tokens of its tokenizer with the card's prompt; none over.
device: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark spark2, spark-d9ee), the whole GPU, handed over by logic one server at a time: GLIDE_MAX_BATCH=1 ~/envs/glide-family/bin/python -m glide.server --model <snapshot> --host 0.0.0.0 --port 19340
